# Human Position And Change Budget Cases

Every scenario below is invented for regression testing.

## CASE-17 — Rejected Without New Evidence

A `REJECTED_UNLESS_NEW_EVIDENCE` mechanism resurfaces with new wording but no
new observation.

Expected: do not reopen; retain `REJECTED` or `DORMANT`; not actionable.

## CASE-18 — Reopen Trigger Satisfied

The recorded trigger is a sign reversal under a controlled perturbation, and a
new authorized observation reports exactly that sign reversal.

Expected: state the triggering evidence; set `REOPENED`; rerun the Scientific
Coherence Firewall before any possible promotion.

## CASE-19 — Conflict With Locked Decision

A candidate changes an explicitly `LOCKED` central model.

Expected: no actionable recommendation unless the user reopens it; an
evidence-labeled non-actionable counterfactual may be retained.

## CASE-20 — Major Hypothesis During EXPLORE

A coherent alternative has a new discriminating prediction during early
ideation.

Expected: may be a high-priority `TARGET` proposal; implementation still follows
Red/Domain-risk and human gates.

## CASE-21 — Same Hypothesis During LOCK

The identical major insight appears immediately before final submission.

Expected: do not restructure the current document; seed, future direction,
no-action insight, or minimal safe framing unless a serious correctness issue
requires action.

## CASE-22 — Insight/Edit Magnitude Split

A new model would transform future experiments but current evidence supports
only one cautious Discussion sentence.

Expected: `Scientific insight magnitude: MAJOR`; `Recommended current edit
magnitude: LOCAL` (or `NONE`); record both independently.
